reviewer: game_poo_full direct visual self review; independent acceptance pending

face.observation: Faceted silver upward flame crest has central groove; low half-lidded eyes and short mouth retain PO identity within clean brushed silver face.

silhouette.observation: Broad flat red riveted shoulder plates, trapezoid riveted chest and squared silver boots create compact structural stance distinct from soft DQ/DDQ.

emblem.observation: Riveted circular badge retains vertical dark-scale / silver division and center water droplet; its rim is circular rather than GA hexagonal.

material.observation: Cast silver facets, firm red riveted panels and support stance retain 370W structural material meaning without suggesting all properties increase together.

thumbnail72.observation: Actual 72px output preserves angular crest, flat wide shoulders and square boots; red torso and contrasting round emblem remain distinguishable.
